endpoint.display: South Congress Dental Care Interim FHIR Server (WADO-RS)

note.text: Real image data is DICOM, not carried in this FHIR resource — this ImagingStudy is a pointer/metadata layer only, per HL7's own spec (confirmed earlier in this project). Retrieval at Interaction 2 happens via CDex -> this ImagingStudy -> a real DICOMweb WADO-RS call against the referenced endpoint's PACS, using the series Study Instance UID above. This is the dental-to-dental support-a-pull direction (not UC01's separate-push, since neither side here is a medical EHR).
